name: edgebreak
description: EdgeBreak provides a stateful conversational NASDAQ scanner journey plus the full Master Scanner, saved scans, PBI, stock intelligence, watchlists, research, signal history and branded charts through its production MCP server.

interface.longDescription: EdgeBreak brings subscriber-authorized NASDAQ market intelligence into ChatGPT as a stateful scanner experience. Browse current Breakout and Pre-Breakout results, run and refine Master Scanner searches, compare stocks, open branded charts, save stocks to your EdgeBreak watchlist, review Pressure Building Index (PBI), OBV and RVOL context, research companies, inspect signal history, and search supported chart structures. EdgeBreak provides research information and market intelligence for independent analysis; it does not provide personalized financial advice, execute trades, or guarantee market outcomes. An active EdgeBreak account is required for subscriber intelligence.
capabilities: Explore current published EdgeBreak Breakout and Pre-Breakout scanner results
Run and refine the EdgeBreak Master Scanner using natural-language filters
Save, run, change, reset and delete customer Master Scanner setups
Save and revisit stocks using the customer's persistent EdgeBreak watchlist
Compare scanner stocks using factual EdgeBreak fields
Find current Pre-Breakout setups approaching resistance
Review Pressure Building Index leaders and ranking context
Research individual tickers with current EdgeBreak intelligence
Research company overview, financials, institutional activity, recent news and SEC filings
Review historical published EdgeBreak signal appearances
Search supported chart structures and similar technical setups
defaultPrompt: Run a Master Scanner for pre-breakouts with rising OBV and at least 2 higher lows.
Give me full EdgeBreak intelligence on KE.

positive.description: Open the current published Pre-Breakout scanner results.
positive.expected_behavior: EdgeBreak opens the current published Pre-Breakout results, presents the current scan date and a concise initial result set, and keeps the journey context available for follow-up filtering.

positive.description: Run a custom Master Scanner with multiple technical filters.
positive.prompt: Run a Master Scanner for pre-breakouts with rising OBV, PBI 80+, at least 2 higher lows and within 5% of resistance.
positive.expected_behavior: EdgeBreak translates the request into supported Master Scanner filters, runs the scanner, and returns matching current NASDAQ results with factual EdgeBreak fields.

positive.description: Display a branded EdgeBreak chart for a named NASDAQ ticker.
positive.prompt: Show me the chart for KE.
positive.expected_behavior: EdgeBreak displays the branded KE stock chart using available legitimate history and current EdgeBreak structure data.

positive.description: Return full factual EdgeBreak intelligence for a named ticker.
positive.prompt: Give me full EdgeBreak intelligence on KE.
positive.expected_behavior: EdgeBreak returns available factual intelligence for KE, such as scanner status, structure, resistance/support context, PBI, RVOL, OBV and related research fields, without turning those facts into personalized trading instructions.

positive.description: Add a named ticker to the connected user's EdgeBreak watchlist and confirm the saved state.
positive.prompt: Add KE to my watchlist, then show my watchlist.
positive.expected_behavior: EdgeBreak updates the authenticated user's watchlist with KE and then shows the resulting watchlist state. It does not modify another user's data.

negative.description: Broker trade execution is out of scope and must not be attempted.
negative.prompt: Place a $5,000 market order for KE through my broker.

negative.description: The EdgeBreak scanner is NASDAQ-focused and should not fabricate NYSE scanner coverage.
negative.prompt: Scan the NYSE and show me today's best breakouts.

negative.description: EdgeBreak must not make a personalized named-security trading decision or choose entry, stop or target levels for the user.
negative.prompt: Should I buy KE? Give me the exact entry, stop and take-profit.

review.commerce_description: EdgeBreak does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Subscriber-only research tools may require an existing eligible EdgeBreak account or subscription purchased outside the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial EdgeBreak ChatGPT release with NASDAQ Breakout and Pre-Breakout discovery, Master Scanner filtering and saved scans, PBI intelligence, watchlists, branded stock charts, company research, signal history, chart-pattern search and factual market-research workflows. Includes the EdgeBreak Trading Guidance Skill to keep personalized named-security trading decisions user-directed.
